text:
Ava: Ok silly question for the room: If you could replace one office appliance with a medieval equivalent (e.g., a catapult instead of the printer?), what would you swap and why? 🤔
Diego: Catapult printer = instant paper missiles. But I'd take a bell tower instead of the Slack notifications. One loud 'DONG' per mention :joy:
Priya: Replace microwave with hearth. Lunch takes longer but smells amazing. Also fewer weird plastic noises.
sam (they/them): @Ava I vote for a scribe instead of auto-email replies. Handwritten notes > accidental 'reply all'.
Kara: Office plants as moat? jk. But seriously, swap the coffee machine for a coffee cauldron — communal brewing ceremony! ☕️🔥
ops-bot: Deploy reminder: keep fire safety in mind if you're suggesting hearths in breakout. :fire_extinguisher:
Ava: Love these. Bonus points if the scribe uses calligraphy on branded stationery.
Diego: :thumbsup: meeting pledge — whoever brings me roasted chestnuts gets naming rights for the cauldron.
